dict.string:
Brain Share sends a link, web page, text, or file shared from the Share Sheet to your Brain Cockpit.
It asks for an optional thought, lets you pick a tag, and saves the capture into the Brain Outbox folder first so nothing is lost when you are offline. Then it sends everything waiting in that folder to your Brain Cockpit and removes each item the cockpit accepts.
Setup: when you import this shortcut you type your Brain Cockpit address (starting with https, no trailing slash) and paste your access token.

Shortcuts generated by Shortcuts Playground. May contain mistakes. Always check the shortcut's actions first.
This shortcut was created via the following user prompt:
> Brain Share: send a shared link or text to Brain OS, offline-safe

Check the Brain Cockpit address before anything else - Input uses the Text from the address question above - If the address ends with a slash, a notification explains how to fix it and the shortcut stops
Your Brain address ends with a slash. That breaks every request. Delete this shortcut and re-import it, typing the address without the final /.
Ask for an optional thought and choose a tag - Ask for Input starts with a single space, so leaving it alone means no thought - Choose from List uses the List of tags that follows
Combine the thought with the shared content - Get Text from Input reads the Shortcut Input - Text puts the answer from Ask for Input first, then a blank line, then the text from Get Text from Input
Build a unique capture key - Each Random Number picks a nine digit number - Text joins the first and second Random Number with a dash

Save the capture into Brain Outbox before any network request, so it survives being offline - Dictionary text is the combined Text from above - Dictionary tag is the Chosen Item from Choose from List - Save File uses the Dictionary and names the file with the capture key
Send everything waiting in Brain Outbox
Loop over every file waiting in Brain Outbox - Repeat with Each uses the Contents of Folder above - Repeat Item is the file currently being sent
Voice notes go to the audio route, everything else goes to the normal capture route - Input uses the Text that holds the file extension - The condition checks that the extension is m4a

Handle the reply to the voice note upload - Input uses the id value read from the reply above - If it has a value the file is deleted and a notification confirms it; otherwise the error details are read

Read the error details from the voice note reply - Input uses the error value read from the reply above - If it has a value the explanation and next step are shown; otherwise a general not-sent notice is shown

Not sent — the cockpit didn't answer like the cockpit. Check the address has no trailing slash and isn't behind a login page. Your capture is kept in Files › Shortcuts › Brain Outbox and is sent automatically next run.
Handle the reply to the capture upload - Input uses the id value read from the reply above - If it has a value the file is deleted and a notification confirms it; otherwise the error details are read

Read the error details from the capture reply - Input uses the error value read from the reply above - If it has a value the explanation and next step are shown; otherwise a general not-sent notice is shown

Not sent — the cockpit didn't answer like the cockpit. Check the address has no trailing slash and isn't behind a login page. Your capture is kept in Files › Shortcuts › Brain Outbox and is sent automatically next run.
What is your Brain Cockpit address? Start with https and leave off any trailing slash.
Paste your Brain Cockpit access token (api.auth_token).
